content: On invocation of EthTSyn_RxIndication the ingress time stamp shall be retrieved for t4 from the EthIf via E EthIf_GetIngressTimeS- 19 of 87 Document ID 676: AUTOSAR_SWS_TimeSyncOverEthernet Specification of Time Synchronization over Ethernet AUTOSAR CP R21-11 tamp on ingress of the Pdelay_Resp message, if EthTSynHardwareTimestamp- Support is set to TRUE. If the StbM does not use the Ethernet controller as source for the Virtual Local Time (refer to parameter StbMLocalTimeHardware in [2]), the EthTSyn shall convert the ingress time stamp to the Virtual Local Time as used in the StbM.
